objective: Split artificial and natural fertilizers into distinct commodity streams. Add Artificial Fertilizer Plant with physically-scaled BOM consuming N/P/K/Sulfur/Ammonia. Add PhosphateRock and Potash as new mineable commodities linked to geological formations (Sedimentary for phosphate, Evaporite for potash). Define import fallback via B2B trade mechanics for countries lacking domestic deposits, with explicit FreightCapacity cost accounting for cross-border transport. Update livestock methods to generate NaturalFertilizer byproduct. Fix initialize_agricultural_profiles zero-coverage bug and verify agricultural working-capital loan issuance.
constraints: RAM protection: cargo check and cargo clippy only
Rule 2: All fertilizer costs must scale by average_wage or physical inputs, no magic numbers
Rule 3: Physical BOM for fertilizer plants must be static (N, P, K inputs); financial costs derived from market prices
Rule 5: Fertilizer allocation to farms must use market clearing or pro-rata based on farm acreage, not arbitrary splits
Rule 13: Artificial Fertilizer Plant must have distinct MethodSlots (Production, Automation, Organization)
Rule 14: Extend existing Commodity::Fertilizers for artificial fertilizers; add NaturalFertilizer, PhosphateRock, Potash as new variants
Rule 15: Fertilizer plant inputs must scale by plant capacity (tons/day), not flat rates
Rule 19: Raw material transport from mine to fertilizer plant must consume FreightCapacity; no teleporting
Rule 20: Mine reserves for PhosphateRock and Potash must have hard limits with depletion behavior matching existing geology.rs patterns
Rule 22: Do not modify military, sports, environment, or housing modules
Rule 23: Surgically append new Commodity variants, geological formation links, and production methods; do not overwrite existing entries
RAW MATERIAL SOURCING: PhosphateRock from Sedimentary formations. Potash from Evaporite/SaltDome formations. Sulfur from VolcanicArc. Ammonia already exists.

IMPORT LOGISTICS: Importing fertilizer plant company pays ALL FreightCapacity costs for cross-border B2B imports of PhosphateRock/Potash. freight_cost = freight_quantity * market_price(FreightCapacity) * distance_modifier. Existing freight_cost_reserve_ratio in b2b_orders.rs is applied. If company cannot afford freight, import order fails.
api_contracts: state/src/registries/enums.rs — Add Commodity::NaturalFertilizer, Commodity::PhosphateRock, Commodity::Potash variants
state/src/society/geography.rs — Add PhosphateRock to Sedimentary formation commodities, Potash to Evaporite/SaltDome formation commodities
state/src/society/planet.rs — Add PhosphateRock and Potash to GeologicalVein generation for appropriate formation types
state/src/registries/production_methods_data.rs — Add ArtificialFertilizerPlant production methods consuming Sulfur + Ammonia + PhosphateRock + Potash; add phosphate mining and potash mining methods

state/src/economy/trade/b2b_orders.rs — Ensure B2B import orders for PhosphateRock and Potash apply freight_cost_reserve_ratio and debit importing company's liquid_capital for freight costs, crediting the freight transport company
state/src/agriculture.rs — Fix initialize_agricultural_profiles to correctly assign profiles during generation
state/src/economy/production/ — Update livestock methods to output NaturalFertilizer as byproduct
completion_criteria: All fertilizer-related tests pass. PhosphateRock and Potash are mineable from appropriate geological formations. Artificial Fertilizer Plant BOM has physically sourced inputs. International imports of PhosphateRock/Potash via B2B trade include explicit FreightCapacity costs paid by the importing company. initialize_agricultural_profiles achieves >0% coverage. Agricultural firms receive working-capital loans. M0 conservation maintained. Iron CI/CD green.
harmonization_notes: v6 resubmission. No content changes from v5 — rejected only for re-harmonization. Updated roadmap reference to roadmap-006-001.
